In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of whey in fermented beverages does not interfere in the chemical and physical properties of the final product.
dairy beverages formulated using ABY 1 culture and 50% whey concentration have shown the best physical and chemical characteristics.
the dairy beverages with higher whey concentration had lower fat, dry extract and protein contents, higher viscosity, but no difference for proteolysis rate and no change in lactose content.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the dairy beverage formulated with 30 % of Minas cheese, using the YC-180 traditional culture, showed higher values for viscosity and proteolysis, besides having the highest protein content.
dairy beverages prepared using AB-1 culture have shown higher proteolysis values, while beverages prepared using YC culture have shown higher viscosity values.
the dairy beverages with 30% of Minas cheese were the most suitable to be used as probiotics.

dairy beverages formulated with whey have shown to be a good source of protein and fat, and that the use of probiotic cultures has not interfered with their physical and chemical characteristics.
